title: Mine reflections as a trouble source, and measure the clean-run collapse
action:
Turn a recorded reflection into a mined lesson (D3 0872f328, superseding letter-reflection LR4 bb73e821), and make the collapse of the clean-run answer visible (D6 7760339d).

RED FIRST. Before touching the miner, write the test that proves a reflection appearing in two distinct runs' letters becomes exactly one lesson decision. Run it. SEE IT RED against today's trouble_lines and say so in the cap proof. Only then widen the source set. A green count is not evidence that your new test ran (docs/knowledge/patterns/20260818-a-green-count-is-not-evidence-that-your-new-test-ran.md) — name the new test by function name in the proof line.

(1) THE SOURCE SET — packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/mailbox_digest.rs. `trouble_lines` (lines 710-728) walks the SECTION_BROKEN bullets and the three MINED_DEPARTURE_KINDS (lines 631-635). Add the letter's reflection items as a third trouble source.

(2) THE TOKENIZED TEXT IS THE REFLECTION ITEM'S `what` FIELD, NEVER THE RENDERED BULLET. The bullet is `<what> — better: <better>` (mailbox.rs:1767-1774); tokenizing the joined line would make the same mistake with a differently worded counterfactual fail to match, and re-parsing rendered prose is what this file's own doc forbids for departures (see the comment at 705-709). compose_letter maps every entry to an item, so `item.what` is available structurally — use it, exactly as the departure branch already uses `departure.what`.

(3) REUSE, DO NOT RE-DERIVE. normalize_shape (659-675) and shape_token (680-685) stay the single derivation, and the existing spent-token dedup (the walk at 781) still refuses a token any earlier lesson row spent, active or superseded. No second hashing path.

(4) THE CLEAN-RUN ANSWER IS NEVER MINED. rbl-1 added its entry kind; exclude it here by the same predicate family, never by string match. A line meaning nothing-went-wrong must not teach a lesson, exactly as the plan-followed statement does not.

(5) THE COLLAPSE IS MEASURED (D6). The feedback digest gains the clean-run-to-reflection ratio — how many caps answered clean against how many recorded a real reflection — so a reflexive clean answer on every close shows up as a visible number instead of as silence nobody notices. Locate the feedback digest yourself (`bee feedback digest`), reserve its file before writing, and keep the addition to a counted line: it is a witness, not a guard, and it must never refuse anything.

Do NOT touch the close door, the cap, or the doctrine files: those are rbl-1, already capped.
acceptance: A reflection whose `what` appears in the letters of two distinct runs produces exactly one lesson-tagged decision citing both letters; the same reflection with a differently worded `better` still matches, because only `what` is tokenized; a clean-run answer never produces a lesson; a shape any earlier lesson row already spent is never logged again; and the feedback digest reports the clean-run-to-reflection ratio.
